q1.a: Eve is an AI booking assistant for your business. Guests chat, Eve checks real Cal.com availability, and books the appointment.

q2.a: No. Open slots come from your connected Cal.com calendar. If it’s not free there, Eve won’t offer it.

q3.q: Do I need a credit card to try it?
q3.a: No. Start a free trial, connect Cal.com, and book from the demo or your own workspace page.

q4.a: Yes. Guests pick EN or VI on the public booking page. Your dashboard language is separate.

q5.a: WhatsApp and voice are on the roadmap for Premium and Enterprise. Web chat and Cal.com booking ship today.

q6.q: Who owns the calendar and data?
q6.a: You do. Eve books into your Cal.com account and keeps workspace data scoped to your tenant.
